findings.body: previousTaskIdRef tracks the previous task ID and prevents focus changes unless the ID explicitly changes, safely handling React 18 StrictMode double-invokes.
findings.title: Focus preservation

remaining_risks: The implementation depends on standard synchronous React state updates for focus. Rapid, concurrent task transitions could potentially cause a race condition, though unlikely in normal user interaction.
summary: The implementation correctly uses previousTaskIdRef to prevent focus stealing during StrictMode double-invokes. Task transitions appropriately move focus to the ritual Start/Pause button. The completeTask function handles a null currentTaskId without conflicting with headerRef. Tests validate this behavior. No scope creep or secrets were introduced.
